summary.description: One short sentence (same language as the deck) summarizing exactly what was changed. Shown to the user before they confirm.

name.description: The deck's name. Copy the CURRENT name unchanged unless the instruction explicitly asked to rename/retitle it.

topic.description: The deck's topic tag (2-4 hyphenated lowercase nouns). Copy the CURRENT topic unchanged unless the new content requires a different one.

desc.description: The deck's description. Copy the CURRENT description unchanged unless the instruction explicitly asked to change it.

cards_to_add.description: Brand-new flashcards to append. Leave EMPTY unless the instruction explicitly asked to add card(s).

front.description: Front side: a term, concept, question or prompt. Keep it short (max ~25 words).

back.description: Back side: the definition, answer or explanation. Concise but complete (max ~40 words).

cards_to_remove_ids.description: IDs (copied verbatim from the current cards list below) of cards to delete. Leave EMPTY unless the instruction explicitly asked to remove card(s).

cards_to_update.description: Existing cards to modify in place. Include ONLY the cards the instruction actually asked to change - never rewrite untouched cards.

id.description: The id of the existing card being updated, copied verbatim from the current list.
